run_INVOCATION_DEFECTS_TEST: run the gRPC invocation defects unit tests to verify client-side exception handling for all RPC patterns
test_Handler_unary_unary: test the _Handler handle_unary_unary method that echoes requests and sets trailing metadata on the servicer context
test_Handler_stream_stream: test the _Handler handle_stream_stream method that yields requests back with trailing metadata for stream-stream RPCs
test_GenericHandler_service: test the _GenericHandler service method that routes incoming RPC calls to the appropriate _Handler method by method name
test_FailAfterFewIterationsCounter: test the FailAfterFewIterationsCounter iterator that raises a Defect after a specified number of iterations
